_about: n>1 controlled writer experiment (reviewer fix #1,#2,#4). Fixed canonical upstream; only {model,arm,sample} vary. Three arms: naive (doc+facts+analysis), summary (lossy short summary), toap (analysis only). Outputs are verbatim real subagent generations. Accuracy scored deterministically by writer_experiment.py covers() (bias-free). All 33 samples covered 4/4 rubric themes.
model_note: Haiku n=5/arm, Opus n=3/arm, Sonnet n=3/arm. Runtime tokens overhead-polluted (Haiku ~20k, Sonnet/Opus ~12.5k); tiktoken on output is the comparable measure.
